value.data: Offers a new benchmark in residential luxury. Strategically situated near Outer Ring Road, Sarjapur Road, and Old Madras Road, boasting unparalleled connectivity.. Configurations: 3 BHK, 4 BHK

Residents generally express satisfaction with Radiance Platinum's prime location, luxurious amenities, and robust security. However, common frustrations revolve around traffic congestion and parking limitations in the vicinity, alongside some financial considerations.

data: prime location with excellent access to amenities, schools, hospitals, and commercial hubs
